status: DRAFT skeleton. The coordinator pins every null under `pins` and the `veto` pins, then freezes it (commit, then stamp that commit's sha here). The runner refuses to score while frozen_sha is UNFROZEN, while any pin is null, or if the committed blob differs.
pin_note: coordinator pins before any M1-M3 scoring

plan.binding: r3 + r3.1 + r3.2 + F13-R35 (LAMP remaining-hours feature). F13-R36 (B1 UNDERPOWERED) is out of scope here.

fixed_by_plan.holdout_rule: rows on or after holdout_start are REFUSED by the fit, the folds, the scorer and the runner; open_holdout is never called
fixed_by_plan.champion: M0 = nbp_calibration.fit_calibration, module byte-unchanged (sha pinned by test_nbp_calibration_module_is_byte_unchanged)
fixed_by_plan.test_statistic: delta = CRPS(M0prime) - CRPS(M3), positive = M3 better
fixed_by_plan.scorer: nbp_calibration.crps_numerical with center = the blend mu
fixed_by_plan.distribution: Student-t, log sigma = c + d*log(NBP sd) floored; the disagreement term e*log(sd of sources' mu) is a separate, later ladder step, never in the primary arms
fixed_by_plan.weights: shrinkage toward a sum of 1 (lambda * n * (sum(w) - 1)^2), not a hard box
fixed_by_plan.nesting: a row scores with the longest present prefix of [LAMP, PFM, GFS MOS]; LAMP missing means the row scores as M0prime
fixed_by_plan.bootstrap: stationary (Politis-Romano), circular, by climate day averaged across stations and horizons
fixed_by_plan.lb_rule: one-sided 97.5 % lower bound must be > 0 AND >= floor, for both CRPS(M0prime) - CRPS(M3) and CRPS(M0) - CRPS(M3) (R25)
fixed_by_plan.floor_rule: floor = floor_multiple * sample SD of the M0 fold-to-fold mean CRPS, committed before M1-M3 are scored
fixed_by_plan.fold_sign_rule: same sign in >= ceil(0.75 * n_folds) folds
fixed_by_plan.fold_rule: blocked within each NBM version and within each source-break segment; a segment enters only with >= 2 blocks of >= 28 held days and >= 28 train days; no fold straddles a source break; v5 never mints (AS-R14)
fixed_by_plan.lag_rule: rerun with every source lag +60 min; LB must be >= 0 (R25) and the rows lost are reported
fixed_by_plan.negative_control: labels shuffled within version; the shuffled delta is reported and must be ~0

lamp_feature.name: lamp_rem_max_f
lamp_feature.definition: max over lavtxt + lavtxt_ext forecast hours with valid_ts strictly after the anchor and inside the LST climate day, from the latest run with available_at (frozen upper-bound lag) before the anchor
lamp_feature.peak_rule: lamp_peak_covered is true only when every LST hour 12..18 after the anchor is present; otherwise the feature is MISSING (m_lamp = 1) and nothing is imputed
lamp_feature.blend_input: L = max(obs_so_far, lamp_rem_max_f); at a D-1 anchor obs_so_far is undefined and L = lamp_rem_max_f
lamp_feature.obs_so_far: from the obs path only (obs available_at before the anchor), never from LAMP
lamp_feature.m0prime_inputs: NBP q50 and NBP sd, plus obs_so_far when defined (LAMP credit is not confused with observation credit)
lamp_feature.strict_24h_max: diagnostic only, never read by the blend

diagnostics: mean log score on the rung ladder

outcomes.HELD_LEAK_AUDIT: delta mean > leak_audit_spread_multiple * M0 fold SD
outcomes.NO_SKILL: otherwise: record NO_SKILL, stop Phase D, keep B1 and C1 running

pin_units.m0_prime_tolerance_crps_f: absolute CRPS in degF; M0prime worse than M0 by more than this refuses ACCEPT
pin_units.station_tolerance_crps_f: absolute CRPS in degF; a station whose mean (M0prime - M3) is below minus this is degraded
pin_units.source_breaks: list of ISO dates from A0; a fold never straddles one
pin_units.rung_edges_f: integer degF edges for the rung-ladder log score
pin_units.champion_cdf_method: NORMAL | PCHIP_NORMAL_TAILS | SKEW_NORMAL, the CdfMethod the committed champion uses
pin_units.embargo_days: integer days (>= 2, FB-R6): every day within this many days of a held block is dropped from the training of M0, the pooled-M0 sensitivity AND every blend arm
pin_units.anchors: FB-R1, read by multisource_blend_features_build.py: object {"D-1": {"kind": "utc", "hour": 18}, "D0": {"kind": "lst", "hour": 10}, "D0_sensitivity": {"kind": "lst", "hour": 12}, "offset_rule": "fixed_standard_time_never_dst"}. A utc anchor is that UTC hour on the day before the climate day; an lst anchor is that local-STANDARD hour on the climate day (EST 15Z, CST 16Z, PST 18Z for hour 10). D0_sensitivity builds a separate file pair, never mixed into the primary pair.
pin_units.source_lags_ns: FB-R4, integer nanoseconds per source key lamp-mdl, lav-iem, pfm, mos-gfs, obs: availability = nominal time + lag. Provisional basis: lamp-mdl max(60 min, C1 max); lav-iem the same + 30 min; pfm WMO issuance + 60 min; mos-gfs runtime + 5 h; obs report time + 15 min. The builder refuses any value below the R29 floor (lamp-mdl 60 min, lav-iem 90 min, pfm 60 min, mos-gfs 5 h, obs 15 min). Frozen only after >= 14 days of C1 measurement (R29); every value's basis is flagged in the build report.
pin_units.obs_source: FB-R3/FB-R15, a string label for the obs_so_far path; the builder accepts only iem_routine_metar_tgroup_round_half_up_f (the routine-METAR store, T group quantised through round_half_up_f). The 1-min archive is no longer a source; its raw running max and 5-min arm are descriptive, non-METAR arms only.
pin_units.obs_cadence_seconds: FB-R13, integer seconds between routine METAR readings; the builder refuses any value other than 3600 (obs_so_far is the running max of routine hourly METAR values only; interval rows and specials are excluded).
pin_units.obs_routine_minute_by_station: FB-R13, object {icao: minute of the hour 0..59} of each station's routine METAR report; FB-R15: a VALIDATION FILTER over the routine-METAR store (rows at another minute are excluded and counted). Derived by multisource_blend_inputs_obs.modal_routine_minute_by_station from routine report timestamps; the coordinator pins it (reported, never auto-applied).
pin_units.lag_arm_max_lost_fraction: fraction in [0, 1] (review fix 2): the runner refuses to emit a verdict when the +60 min shift loses more than this share of the primary file's (station, climate day, horizon) keys; the lag arm is compared with the primary on the common keys only (paired difference), so a larger loss would make the sensitivity answer a different question

veto.label: descriptive only, carries no verdict (R8, R15)

take_rule.citation: src/breezy/strategy/forecast_quantile_ladder/decision.py:349-355 (net EV against the cost, take iff net > forecast_margin); margin src/breezy/strategy/forecast_quantile_ladder/margin.py:30-37; fee src/breezy/strategy/weather_common/costs.py:155-183; reached through the shipped evaluate() via scripts/analysis/fq_evaluate_shim.py (call_evaluate; re-exported by fq_mc_livedata as _call_evaluate)
take_rule.order: YES: ev_net(p_lower, cost); NO: ev_net_no(p_upper, cost); cost = fee theta*p*(1-p) + slippage floor; take iff net > margin(h)
take_rule.fixed_by_code: theta, slippage floor, h_hours and bound halfwidth are the scripts/analysis/fq_mc_livedata.py LoopConfig defaults, read from the code and never copied
take_rule.proxy_deviation: no out-of-fold bootstrap draws exist, so p_lower and p_upper are p_hat -/+ the LoopConfig bound halfwidth

veto.reference_note: no tape exists before 2026-08-30, so the pre-07-01 proxy needs a pre-registered reference ask; the coordinator pins its kind and value. Until then blend_veto_descriptive.py refuses to run. Kinds: raw_nbp_cdf = {kind, spread_prob} (the uncalibrated NBP NORMAL rung probability plus spread_prob, YES p + s, NO 1 - p + s); const = {kind, price} is unsuitable (rung-blind), tests and smoke runs only.
veto.champion_output: out-of-fold only; a fitted-in-sample champion is refused
